However, the context does describe the performance of the unaligned model Phi-2 when enhanced by OG-Narrator. Without OG-Narrator, Phi-2, which is not fine-tuned for chat or aligned through RLHF, was largely ineffective as a Buyer, exhibiting very low valid and deal rates. When OG-Narrator was applied, Phi-2's valid rate increased by 19 times and its deal rate by 117 times, making it a significantly more reliable agent in bargaining tasks, despite remaining unaligned. OG-Narrator also enabled Phi-2 and other models to achieve over 100% Share and exploit the ChatGPT Seller.
